name: Zhejiang Natural Outdoor Goods Inc.
summary: Zhejiang Natural Outdoor Goods Inc. engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of outdoor sports products in China and internationally. Its products primarily include automatic inflatable mattresses, inflatable beds, waterproof bags, ice bags, pillows, seat cushions, TPU composite fabrics, shelters, and other products. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Taizhou, China.
